text: Port Hardy Hospital ED will be closed from 7 a.m. to 11 a.m. on October 12 due to limited care provider availability. It is expected to reopen at 11 a.m. All other hospital services remain open. If you have a medical emergency call 9-1-1 or go to Port McNeill Hospital.

Port Hardy Hospital ED will be closed from 7 a.m. to 1 p.m. on October 11 due to limited staffing. It is expected to reopen at 1 p.m. All other hospital services remain open. If you have a medical emergency call 9-1-1 or go to Port McNeill Hospital if possible.
